ops.text: Known gotcha in acme-platform web app: the sign-in redirect loop happens when /login is missing from publicRoutes in apps/web/middleware.ts, and afterSignInUrl must be /dashboard (login page and NEXT_PUBLIC_CLERK_AFTER_SIGN_IN_URL) or it bounces.
State management in the acme-platform web app: server state is TanStack Query, client state is zustand, and the two must not be mixed.
Worker tests run with `pnpm --filter worker test` and use an in-memory Redis mock (ioredis-mock), so no real Redis is needed.
Logging convention in acme-platform: use pino with structured logs; no console.log.
Issues are tracked in Linear under the ACME team; branch names start with the lowercase Linear id, e.g. acme-123-short-slug.
The acme-platform API is Express 4; it verifies Clerk session JWTs with @clerk/backend in apps/api/src/plugins/auth.ts (requireAuth), and returns 401 with token_expired / invalid_token on failure.
Versioning in acme-platform uses Changesets: run `pnpm changeset` for anything user-facing (e.g. the invoice timezone change counted).
Standing rule from Jordan: never run destructive database commands (drop, truncate, reset) without asking first, even on the local database.

In the last game day an RDS failover took 90 seconds; the API rides it out by retrying DB connections for 2 minutes (connectRetryWindowMs 120_000 in apps/api/src/db/pool.ts), so that window must stay >= 2 minutes.
Invoice dates in the web app are shown in the org's time zone (org.timeZone, via formatDate(iso, timeZone)), not UTC; Vancouver agencies had seen the wrong day.

The acme CLI (packages/cli) is bundled with tsup into dist/index.js (single ESM file, node18 target, shebang banner, bin `acme`); commands are commander Commands in src/commands/ registered in src/index.ts.

Onboarding gotcha: on Apple Silicon, sharp and canvas need Rosetta-free builds (do not run the terminal under Rosetta); after switching Node versions run `pnpm rebuild sharp` or image uploads in the dashboard crash on startup.
API tests in acme-platform run against a real database started by Testcontainers, so Docker must be running; if Docker is stopped the suite hangs rather than failing (check `docker info`).

Ops runbook facts: background jobs retry with exponential backoff (5 attempts), then go to dead-letter queue `dlq` and alert in Slack #alerts; production Postgres is RDS Multi-AZ with 14-day backups and restores go to a new instance, never over the live one; deploy rollback docs are still a TODO.
API health endpoint is GET /healthz (localhost:4000); it checks Postgres and Redis and returns 200 only when both are up.
Licensing: the acme-platform repo is proprietary (root LICENSE, all rights reserved, Acme Inc.), while packages/cli is MIT licensed (packages/cli/LICENSE).

Jordan states the acme-platform database is MySQL 8 (docs/architecture.md Data section now says so; the API owns the schema and migrations live in apps/api/migrations). Some docs/comments elsewhere still say Postgres.
The worker consumes RabbitMQ queues (invoices.reminders, webhooks.outbound, exports), one consumer per queue.

Build error "Module not found: Can't resolve 'fs'" means a server-only module was imported into a client bundle; fix by adding `import "server-only"` to the module and keeping it out of client components (use a server component or route handler).
`pnpm dev` at the repo root starts web, api and worker together via Turborepo.
Rule: never hand-edit generated files under dist/ or *.gen.ts (regenerate instead).

packages/cli/dist/index.js is still tracked in git (force-added despite dist/ being gitignored) and was hand-patched by Marco Bianchi in a91c3e2 (2026-07-08); it is stale. Jordan said to ask Marco first and leave it for now.

Error reporting goes to Sentry (DSN from SENTRY_DSN env var), including CLI failures; feature flags are managed in GrowthBook (the invoices export command is behind flag cli-invoices-export, which still needs creating in GrowthBook).
CLI tests (packages/cli) are Vitest snapshot tests of stdout.
Standing rule from Jordan: never use git stash; commit work in progress to the branch instead.

Node version is 18 LTS everywhere (worker included): do not use Node 20+ APIs such as toSorted, toReversed, Object.groupBy, Array.fromAsync, Promise.withResolvers. Known leftover: Object.groupBy in apps/web/lib/group.ts (swap for reduce, deferred).
Run the acme CLI locally from source with `pnpm --filter @acme/cli dev -- <args>` (tsx, no build needed); point at an API with ACME_API_URL (e.g. https://api.staging.example.com).

invoice-reminder job (services/worker/src/jobs/invoice-reminder.ts) is idempotent via db.reminderLog.claim(invoiceId, kind, sentOn) on table reminder_log (unique invoice_id/kind/sent_on); RabbitMQ redeliveries had caused customers to get duplicate reminders.

The worker Docker image uses node:20-slim with libvips from apt (not alpine like the api) on purpose: sharp segfaults on the alpine musl image (Priya Shah, e22b9d0, April 2026). To shrink it, use a multi-stage build copying only production node_modules.
Excel garbles accented names in CSV exports (e.g. Cafe Lumiere); the CLI invoices export has a --bom flag (off by default, CSV only) that prefixes a UTF-8 BOM.
Merge rule: every PR needs one approval from CODEOWNERS and green CI. .github/CODEOWNERS has no line for packages/cli/ (falls back to @acme/eng-leads); worth adding an owner before the CLI export PR.

The API talks to the database through PgBouncer in transaction mode, so prepared statements must be disabled (prepare: false). Added to pool.ts and the options type in driver.ts, but the driver does not yet pass it to the raw pool.
The api and worker run on EKS; the cluster is named acme-prod (use for logs).

The repo root pins yarn 1.22.22 (packageManager field, yarn.lock v1, no pnpm lockfile) and CI runs `yarn install --frozen-lockfile`; a branch that changes package.json must commit the updated yarn.lock or the CI install step fails.

Secrets: team/dev secrets live in the 1Password vault acme-dev; production secrets live in AWS Secrets Manager. In .env.example put only a placeholder with a comment saying where to get the value (e.g. STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET=whsec_replace_me).
Web styling is Tailwind CSS v4 with CSS-first config in apps/web/app/globals.css (@theme tokens like brand, warn, radius-card); there is no tailwind.config.js and none should be created.
Paging for Stripe webhook failures: the CloudWatch alarm api-stripe-webhook-5xx (more than 5 5xx in 5 min) notifies SNS topic pagerduty-oncall, so the PagerDuty on-call is woken at night.
Linting and formatting use Biome: run `pnpm lint` at the repo root (biome check .); `pnpm biome check --write <path>` autofixes; max line width 120.
Autoscaling: the worker scales with KEDA on queue length (1 to 20 replicas, one per 50 messages); the api uses HPA on CPU at 70% (3 to 12 pods). Manifests in infra/k8s/.

Cost tagging rule: every taggable AWS/Terraform resource needs tags team and env (Priya's script flags anything without them). Jordan's team tag is team=payments. Only aws_s3_bucket is taggable among a bucket's sub-resources.

Exports bucket (infra/s3-exports.tf on branch acme-424-exports-bucket): acme-<env>-exports, private, AES256, objects expire after 30 days; planned for the CLI export to write files to S3 later. Plan for staging was 4 to add, not applied.

Jordan has a personal hiking app called trailmix (Django + htmx, /Users/jordan/code/trailmix). Double-submit of the add-hike form is prevented with hx-disabled-elt and hx-sync="this:drop"; GPX uploads are validated by hikes/validators.py validate_gpx (defusedxml, GPX 1.0/1.1 namespace, trkpt/rtept, 10 MB cap); htmx forms need hx-encoding="multipart/form-data" for uploads.
Staging API returns brief 502s (~40s) during deploys; the CLI api client (packages/cli/src/api.ts apiGet) retries 502/503/504 up to 3 attempts with 500ms/1s backoff plus jitter.

The API omits lineItems for draft invoices (routes/invoices.ts), so in the web app Invoice.lineItems is optional and must be guarded (crashed InvoiceLineItems/InvoiceTotals on draft detail pages in prod, Sentry WEB-1F3).

The monorepo is orchestrated by Turborepo (task pipelines in turbo.json; build depends on ^build and openapi). The OpenAPI spec apps/api/openapi.yaml is generated from zod schemas (apps/api/src/schemas) with `pnpm turbo run openapi --filter api`; never hand-edit the YAML.
Releasing the CLI: merge the Changesets version PR, then the publish job runs `npm publish --provenance`.
CI fails if line coverage drops below 80%; add tests for new route behavior.
Preference: when finished with a task, Jordan wants a short bullet-list summary, not paragraphs.
Business rule: only invoices with status open can be overdue; drafts and voided invoices never count (dashboard OverdueBadge counts open invoices past due only).
Commit messages follow Conventional Commits (feat:, fix:, chore:, with optional scope like fix(web):).
Update docs/ pages when public behavior changes (e.g. new CLI commands go in docs/cli.md).

In the web app, Skeleton (components/ui/Skeleton) is a default export plus SkeletonText; InvoiceRow was renamed InvoiceListItem (and InvoiceRowProps to InvoiceListItemProps) in acme-431-overdue-badge-drafts, which will conflict with Lena's in-progress branch. OrgSummary type lacks timeZone (Org has it).

Resetting the local acme DB to a clean seeded state: stop db, remove the docker volume acme-platform_dbdata, `docker compose up -d db redis`, then run apps/api/scripts/migrate.ts (47 migrations) and seed.ts (3 orgs, 9 users, 24 clients, 180 invoices). Destructive: needs Jordan's explicit ok first.

Team ownership (CODEOWNERS): Lena Fischer owns apps/web with the frontend team; Marco Bianchi owns apps/api and services/worker with the backend team; Priya Shah owns infra/ and .github/ with the platform team; Sam asked Jordan to review new-hire onboarding docs.
